source.name: Employment Scam Aegean Dataset (EMSCAD)
source.publisher: University of the Aegean dataset, distributed through Kaggle

checks: source SHA-256 and MD5 match the checked EMSCAD snapshot
stratified 60/20/20 split creates 10,728 training, 3,576 validation, and 3,576 test posts
categorical encoders and TF-IDF/SVD transformations fit on training data only
threshold selected by validation F1 before test evaluation
test confusion matrix contains 3,399 true negatives, 4 false positives, 47 false negatives, and 126 true positives
keyword frequencies use development data and feature split counts use the training-fitted model
four charts regenerated from the fixed source and random seeds
validation.evaluation: random stratified split, not a time-based holdout

evidenceBoundary: Historical labeled postings support offline model comparison only. They do not establish current scam prevalence, production precision/recall, fairness, job seeker outcomes, or performance on future scam language.
